title: The same funds cycled through several liquidity pools
summary: The same funds move through 3 to 8 liquidity pools in turn over 1 to 12 hours. They mix with legitimate volume on the way.

basis.note: No source read for this design publishes how often a screening tool loses the link at this method. The value is an assumption and means that the trail is lost in 30 cases in 100.

parties.label: the wallet that holds the funds
a new wallet that receives the funds

steps.say: The funds pass through a run of liquidity pools in turn.

basis.note: The report says that the same capital moves among many pools and mixes with legitimate volume. The count of 3 to 8 pools and the waits, which give 1 to 12 hours, are assumed.
